<b>The Wandering Merchant</b> is a [[Wayfarer Wishes|Wayfarer Wish]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== How to Start ==
The Wish can be acquired from [[Songclave|Songclave's]] [[Wishwall]] after discovering the area.

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Jubilana 01.png!Wishwall's location in Songclave
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Jubilana 01.png!Wishwall in Songclave
}}

== Wish ==
To complete the wish, [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] must find [[Jubilana]]'s location within the west part of [[Choral Chambers]]. Jubilana's wares are scattered around Choral Chambers, which can be interacted with to track her pathway.

At this location, Jubilana is hiding from an [[Envoy]] and a [[Choristor]], who have to be defeated to save her and return her to Songclave.

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Jubilana The Wandering Merchant.png!Jubilana's location in Choral Chambers
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Jubilana 02.png!Jubilana hiding in Choral Chambers
}}

== Reward ==
After completing the Wish, Jubilana becomes a merchant in Songclave with various wares for sale.

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Jubilana 01.png!Location of Jubilana in Songclave
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Jubilana 01.png!Jubilana in Songclave
}}
